name: Chuumon
main_effect: [On Play] By trashing 1 card with [Etemon] in its name or [Sukamon] in its name in your hand, return 1 card with [Sukamon] in its name from your trash to your hand.
source_effect: [On Deletion] If this Digimon has [Sukamon] or [Etemon] in its name, you may play 1 [Chuumon] from your trash suspended without paying its cost.
